proposals.rationale: Single job with batch size 1 establishes baseline claim run finish and clean drain stop.
Five jobs at equal priority with batch size 1 exercise sequential single-row claims and FIFO tie-breaking.
Five jobs with distinct priorities and batch size 1 isolate strict priority ordering with one claim per iteration.
Five jobs with distinct priorities and batch size 3 verify batched claim preserves priority order across full batch plus remainder.
Three jobs mixing extreme priorities 0 and 9 with batch size 2 test multi-batch drain and boundary priority handling.
Two identical payloads with different priorities and oversized batch size 3 check no deduplication and single-batch drain.
